title_en: Commentary on al-Mughnī al-Mufīd — Tape Twelve
body_ar: ويقول: ﴿ولا يزالون يقاتلونكم حتى يردوكم عن دينكم إن استطاعوا﴾ فلذلك كلما تكالبت أمم الكفر على المسلمين يزيد ذلك أهل الإيمان إيمانا ويقينا واحتسابا، وكلما جاءت أزمة من أزماتهم انقسم الناس إلى أربعة مواقف، الموقف الأول: موقف أهل الإيمان واليقين وقد بينه الله في سورة الأحزاب في قوله: ﴿ولما رأى المؤمنون الأحزاب قالوا هذا ما وعدنا الله ورسوله وصدق الله ورسوله وما زادهم إلا إيمانا وتسليما﴾
body_en: And He says: {And they will not cease to fight you until they turn you back from your religion, if they are able} (Sūrat al-Baqarah 2:217). For that reason, whenever the nations of unbelief set upon the Muslims together, it only increases the people of faith in faith, in certainty, and in seeking God's reward. And whenever one of their crises comes, people divide into four positions. The first position is the position of the people of faith and certainty, which God set out in Sūrat al-Ahzab in His words: {And when the believers saw the confederates they said, 'This is what God and His Messenger promised us, and God and His Messenger spoke truly' — and it only increased them in faith and in submission} (Sūrat al-Aḥzāb 33:22)

flags.context: The title of the series, appearing in the title of articles 502–516.
options: al-Mughnī al-Mufīd (left untranslated as a work title)
The Sheikh's commentary series on Kitāb al-Tawḥīd
flags.note: Article 516 shows the series expounds Kitāb al-Tawḥīd of Muhammad ibn Abd al-Wahhab, and article 508 quotes the base text in verse, so al-Mughnī al-Mufīd appears to be a versification (naẓm) of that book rather than a separate work by the Sheikh. The Sheikh's office should confirm the work and its author before the title is translated or expanded anywhere in the corpus; it has been left untranslated for now.

flags.context: يزيد ذلك أهل الإيمان إيمانا ويقينا واحتسابا
options: in reckoning the reward with God
flags.note: Iḥtisāb is not in the project glossary. It denotes bearing something while looking to God alone for the recompense. A house rendering should be fixed, since the word recurs across the corpus.

translator_notes: The published page carries only the opening excerpt of this lecture/sermon; the Arabic breaks off mid-sentence and the full text is offered on the site as a downloadable Word document. The English ends exactly where the Arabic ends. Nothing has been supplied to complete it.

This page belongs to the Sheikh's tape series on Kitāb al-Tawḥīd of Muhammad ibn Abd al-Wahhab, identified in article 516, the first tape of the series. Passages in quotation marks are the base text being commented on; the unquoted text is the Sheikh's own commentary. The distinction is load-bearing and has been preserved.
Qur'anic renderings in this file are interpretive translations of meaning, offered to carry the Sheikh's argument in English. They are not a substitute for the Arabic text of the Qur'an.

The Sheikh announces four positions and the written excerpt gives only the first. The remaining three are not in the source; nothing has been supplied for them, and the English must not be read as a complete statement of his schema.
Both Qur'anic quotations are in the Arabic source within its own ornamental brackets; references have been supplied in the English per house style.
